readerCopy.body: A bigger opportunity can make an old insecurity louder simply because there is suddenly more to gain and more to lose. When Jupiter conjoins Chiron, expansion and sensitivity fuse, allowing a promotion, course, audience, trip, teaching role, or generous offer to enlarge the doubt attached to it too. The return of the doubt does not mean the opportunity is wrong. The terms, support, and practical demands provide better evidence than the size of the old reaction.
